title: Orbitals
subtitle: Homage to Dominikus Baur (@dominikus)
description: Generative fine-art homage to Dominikus Baur (@dominikus). A dense cluster of 3D-entangled beaded toroidal filaments coils around a hollow core, framed by high-contrast black and white slicing orbital tracks, floating eccentric satellite orbs, architectural ribbon wings with isoline cross-hatching, and an astrolabe dial on warm archival paper.
